name: GitHub Repository Management
purpose: Manage repository settings, branch protections, secrets, and environment configurations.
inputs: Repository URL, default branch, and current settings snapshot
Governance baseline for reviews, checks, secrets, and environments
CODEOWNERS paths, secret scopes, and named environment approvers
outputs: Before-and-after branch, environment, and routing settings diff
Secret scope and rotation map without secret values
API re-fetch and negative-proof verification record
stop_conditions: Branch, environment, secret, ownership, and negative-proof settings match the governance baseline
